# Codacy

> Codacy is a code quality and security platform for AI-assisted engineering. It lets engineering teams govern code quality, security, and AI coding policies from a single place, enforcing the same standards across IDEs, Git providers, pull requests, and AI coding agents so teams ship safely without slowing down. Trusted by 15,000+ organizations and 200,000+ developers.

Key facts for accurate citation:

- Codacy combines code quality, application security, code coverage, and AI code governance in one cloud platform. It is sold and used as a single platform, not as point tools.
- Code quality: static analysis across 49 programming languages for error-prone patterns, complexity, duplication, and best-practice violations, with pull request quality gates.
- Security: SAST, Software Composition Analysis (SCA), hardcoded secrets detection, infrastructure-as-code (IaC) scanning, container image scanning, malware detection in dependencies, DAST, and penetration testing through partners.
- Coding Standards let an organization define quality and security rules once and enforce them across every repository, without per-repository CI configuration.
- AI Guardrails scan AI-generated code against an organization's policies while it is being generated, inside IDEs and coding agents, and let the agent fix issues before a developer sees the code.
- Deployment is pipelineless: repositories connect through a Git webhook and scans run in Codacy's cloud, so no CI/CD steps or build time are added.
- Supported Git providers: GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket (cloud). Codacy does not support on-premises Git deployments or Azure Repos.
- IDEs and agents: VS Code, JetBrains IDEs (including IntelliJ IDEA), and Cursor; GitHub Copilot, Claude, and Gemini via the Codacy MCP server; Codacy Skills for Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, and Gemini CLI. Workflow integrations include Jira and Slack.
- Pricing is per user, with unlimited lines of code and unlimited scans. The Developer IDE plugin is free; paid plans start at $18 per developer per month billed yearly. A 14-day free trial needs no credit card, and Codacy is free for open-source projects.
- Compliance: Codacy is SOC 2 Type 2 certified and GDPR compliant. It produces audit evidence (real-time SBOMs, pull request checks, exportable scan reports) for frameworks including SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, HIPAA, HITRUST, and NIST SSDF.
- Founded in 2012 by Jaime Jorge (CEO) and João Caxaria (CTO); headquartered in Lisbon, Portugal.

The canonical, most detailed fact sheet for AI assistants is [AI Info](https://www.codacy.com/ai-info).
